source_definition: aggressor k is interval (birth+k,birth+k+1]; quote q is first sampled boundary with changed best quote, so its observed transition lies in (birth+q-1,birth+q]. Transient earlier quote changes may be missed. These are not native event clocks.
correction: The prior smaller-k comparison overstated distinct-bin ordering; replacement counts use non-overlapping intervals and explicitly unresolved overlap. No raw cell values change.
lean_band_meaning: 2.5/50/97.5 percentiles across 200 matched-control draws, not uncertainty over independent trading days and not multiple-testing-adjusted significance.
